definitions.explanation: Waste materials that can be recycled, such as paper, plastic bottles (PET), cans, and glass bottles.

examples.japanese: {資源|しげん}ごみは{水曜日|すいようび}です。
ペットボトルは{資源|しげん}ごみです。
{資源|しげん}ごみは{洗|あら}ってから{出|だ}してください。
examples.english: Please wash recyclables before putting them out.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {資源|しげん}ごみを{出|だ}す: to put out recyclables
- {資源|しげん}ごみの{回収|かいしゅう}: recycling collection
- {資源|しげん}{回収|かいしゅう}{日|び}: recycling day

CATEGORIES:
- ペットボトル: plastic bottles
- {空|あき}{缶|かん}: empty cans
- {空|あき}びん: empty bottles
- {古紙|こし}/{新聞紙|しんぶんし}: paper/newspaper

RELATED:
- {可燃|かねん}ごみ: burnable garbage
- {不燃|ふねん}ごみ: non-burnable garbage
- リサイクル: recycling
